name: Stanislav Dashevskyi
biography: Stanislav Dashevskyi is a Security Researcher at Forescout. He received his PhD from the International Doctorate School in Information and Communication Technologies (ICT) at the University of Trento (Italy) in 2017. His main research interests are open source software, software security, and vulnerability analysis.
